result.title: CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery
result.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/BeyondHeaven/CVaR-RMD
result.summary: Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CVaR-RMD，用 LLM 迭代变异可执行启发式程序，并按异构评估条件下的经验 CVaR 排序候选，在三个组合优化领域提升上尾表现、降低失败率且平均性能不降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以尾部风险替代均值」的候选选择思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中跨实例族、随机种子与推理长度的轨迹/检查点筛选，避免均值指标掩盖罕见但严重的失败模式。
